Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator wrote a flawed greedy algorithm that only advanced coverage up to house_positions[i] + 4 (the tower center) instead of covering the full 4-mile radius to the right (house_positions[i] + 8). The inner while condition used house_positions[i] <= tower_position rather than house_positions[i] <= tower_position + 4, causing an overcount of towers and leading to the incorrect final answer.
